data.contenido:
Wẽnnaam tʋma malɛk a Gabriyɛll pʋg-​sad yʋʋr sẽn boond t’a Maari nengẽ. A yeel-⁠a lame t’a na n doga biig sẽn na n wa lebg rĩm n dɩ naam wakat fãa. La a tog n pʋda biigã yʋʋr t’a Zezi. A Maari rog-⁠a-⁠la rũms roogẽ tɩ pe-​kɩɩmb wa ges-⁠a be. Rap sẽn yit yaang n bao n na n tɩ ges biigã, tɩ ãdg wilg-⁠b sore. D na n bãnga ned ning sẽn kɩt tɩ rapã yã ãdgã, la Wẽnnaam sẽn kogl a Zezi to-⁠to t’a bɛɛbã pa tõog n kʋ-⁠a wã.

Sẽn paase, d na n yãame t’a Zezi sẽn wa n tar yʋʋm 12, a sõsa ne karen-​saam dãmb wẽnd-​doogẽ wã. A sẽn wa n tar yʋʋm 30 a reega lisgu, n sɩng Rĩungã koe-​noog moonego, la a zãmsd nebã wa Wẽnnaam sẽn da tʋm-⁠a t’a wa maanã. A Zezi yãka rap 12 tɩ b lebg a tʋm-​tʋmdba, tɩ b sõngd-⁠a n moond koɛɛgã.

A Zezi maana yel-​soalem wʋsg me. A rɩlga neb kʋʋng ne zĩm bõones a wãn la bur a wãn bala. A sãooga bãad dãmb la a vʋʋg kũ-rãmb menga. Baasgẽ wã, d na n yãa bũmb ning sẽn paam a Zezi a kũumã daare, la b sẽn kʋ-⁠a to-⁠to wã me. A Zezi moona koɛɛgã yʋʋm a tã la pʋɩ-​sʋka. Dẽnd babg a yoobã gomda yɛl sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm 34 la kiis a wãn pʋgẽ yelle.

data.titulo: Malɛk n gom ne a Maari
data.contenido:
PƲG-​SAD ning yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã yʋʋr la a Maari. Yaa Israɛll pʋg-​sad sẽn be Israɛll tẽng a ye sẽn boond tɩ Nazarɛte. Wẽnnaam miime t’a yaa pʋg-​sõngo. Yaa rẽ n so t’a tʋm a malɛk a Gabriyɛll t’a tɩ gom ne-⁠a. Yãmb mii a Gabriyɛll sẽn wa n yeel a Maari bũmb ning bɩ?

A Gabriyɛll yeela a Maari yaa: ‘Mam pʋʋsda foo, bala fo yaa ned Wẽnnaam sẽn ning barka. A Zeova bee ne foom.’ A Maari ra nan zɩ n yã nin-​kãngã ye. A yɛɛsame, bala a ra pa wʋmd a Gabriyɛll goamã võor ye. La a Gabriyɛll yeel-⁠a lame yaa:

‘Maari, da zoe rabeem ye; tɩ bõe, Wẽnnaam ninga foo barka. A na n kɩtame tɩ fo rɩk pʋg n dog biiga, n pʋd a yʋʋr t’a Zezi.’

A Gabriyɛll paasa woto: ‘Biigã na n yɩɩ nin-​kãsenga, la b na n boond-⁠a lame tɩ Wẽnnaam Sẽn-⁠ka-⁠to biiga. A Zeova na n kɩtame t’a lebg rĩm wa a Davɩɩde, la a na n dɩɩ naam wakat fãa, la a naamã ka na n sɛ abada!’

La a Maari soka a Gabriyɛll yaa: ‘Mam na n maana wãn n tõog n dog biig tɩ m nan ka kẽ kãadem la m ka mi raoa?’

A Gabriyɛll yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Wẽnnaam pãngã na n buii foom. Woto yĩnga, b na n boonda biig ning fo sẽn na n dogã tɩ Wẽnnaam biiga. Gese, fo roagd a Elizabɛt me rɩka pʋga. Nebã ra yetame t’a kʋʋlame n pa tõe n le paam biig ye. La a na n doga bi-​ribla. Tɩ bõe, bũmb ka be Wẽnnaam sẽn ka tõe ye.’

Rẽ masã a Maari yeelame yaa: ‘Mam yaa a Zeova tʋm-​tʋmda. Bɩ a kɩt tɩ kell n yɩ wa yãmb sẽn yeelã.’ La malɛka loogame.

A Maari kẽnga tao-​tao n na n tɩ ges a Elizabɛte. A Maari sẽn ta a Elizabɛt nengẽ wã, a Elizabɛt wʋma a koɛɛgã, la biigã sẽn da be a Elizabɛt pʋgẽ wã sũur yɩɩ noog t’a virsi. A Elizabɛt pida ne Wẽnnaam vʋʋsem sõngã, la a yeela a Maari yaa: ‘Wẽnnaam ninga foo bark pagbã fãa sʋka.’ A Maari zĩnda ne a Elizabɛt n kolg kiis a tãab n yaool n lebg n kul Nazarɛte.

A Maari ra segd n kẽe kãadem ne a Zozɛfe. La a Zozɛf sẽn wʋm t’a Maari tara pʋgã, a ra pa rat n kẽ kãadem ne-⁠a yɛs ye. La Wẽnnaam malɛkã yeela a Zozɛf yaa: ‘Kẽ kãadem ne a Maari la f ra zoe rabeem ye. Bala yaa ne Wẽnnaam pãng la a rɩk pʋgã.’ A Zozɛf ne a Maari sɩd kẽe kãadem, n gũud a Zezi rogmã masã.Luk 1:⁠26-⁠56; Matɩe 1:⁠18-⁠25. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii bi-​pɛɛlg ning sẽn be fotã zugã yʋʋr bɩ? A yʋʋr la a Zezi. A Maari rog-⁠a-⁠la rũms roogẽ, n gãneg-⁠a bõensã la rũms a taabã rɩɩb koglg pʋgẽ. La bõe yĩng t’a Zozɛf ne a Maari be rũms roogẽ? Pagbã yaool n pa rogd rũms rotẽ ye, bɩ bõe?

Ad bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b wa be ka wã. Rom naab a Sezaar Ogust ra yiisa noor n wilg tɩ ned kam fãa segd n kẽnga a sẽn dog zĩig ningã n tɩ kɩt tɩ b gʋls a yʋʋrã sebr zugu. A Zozɛf sẽn dog Betlehɛmmã yĩnga, yẽ ne a Maari kẽnga be. La b sẽn ta wã, zĩig ka be n na n gãand ye. Yaa rẽ yĩng la b sẽn be rũms roogẽ wã. Yaa baraar me la a Maari sẽn dog a Zezi wã. La baa fʋɩ pa tar a Zezi ye.



Yãmb nee pe-​kɩɩmbã sẽn wat n na n ges a Zezi wã bɩ? B ra bee weoogẽ wã ne yʋng n gũud b piisã, tɩ vẽenem yãg n bui-⁠ba. Ra yaa malɛk n sigi. Pe-​kɩɩmbã yɛɛsa wʋsgo, la malɛkã yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Da zoe-⁠y rabeem ye. Mam waame n na n togs yãmb koe-​noogo. Zusoabã sẽn yaa Kiristã roga Betlehɛm rũndã. A na n fãaga nebã. Yãmb na n yã-a lame t’a vil ne peend n gãe rũms rɩɩb koglgẽ.’ La wakat kãng bala, malɛgs wʋsg n puk n sɩng Wẽnnaam pẽgre. Pe-​kɩɩmbã kẽnga Betlehɛm tao-​tao n na n tɩ ges a Zezi. La b sɩd yã-a lame.

Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Zezi pa wa kamb a taabã bɩ? Yãmb mii a sẽn sɩd yaa ned ning bɩ? Tẽeg-⁠y tɩ seb-​kãngã sɩngrẽ wã, d ra goma Wẽnnaam pipi biigã yelle. Yẽ n sõng a Zeova n naan saasã ne tẽngã la bũmb a taabã fãa. Bi-​kãng yaa a Zezi.

A Zeova maana yel-​solemde, n dɩk a biigã vɩɩm n ning a Maari pʋgẽ wã. Biigã zĩnda be n bɩ wa kom-​peels a taabã sẽn bɩt b ma rãmbã pʋsẽ to-⁠to n yaool n dogã. La bi-​kãngã yaa Wẽnnaam biiga. A Zezi roga rũms roogẽ Betlehɛm. Dẽnd masã, yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ malɛgsã sũur da noomẽ b sẽn wa n na n togs nebã t’a Zezi rogame wã.Luk 2:​1-⁠20. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB nee ãdgã sẽn yãgdã bɩ? Rap nins yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã yita yaanga. Yaa neb sẽn get ãdsã n togsd yɛlã võore. B yãa ãdgã n pʋgda, n tẽed t’a na n tall-⁠b lame n kẽng nin-​kãseng nengẽ. Rapã wa n taa Zerizalɛm n sok tɩ biig ning sẽn na n wa lebg Zʋɩf rãmbã rĩma bee yɛ? Yaa Israɛll nebã la b sẽn boond tɩ Zʋɩf rãmbã. Rapã leb n yeelame yaa: ‘Tõnd yãa biigã ãdgã tõnd sẽn wa n be yaangã, la tõnd waame n na n waoog-⁠a.’

A Herood sẽn yaa Zerizalɛm rĩmã sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, a sũurã sãamame. A ra pa rat tɩ ned a to lebg rĩm n deeg yẽ zĩigã ye. A boola maan-​kʋʋdbã kãsem dãmb n sok n ges biig ning sẽn na n wa lebg Zʋɩf rãmbã rĩmã sẽn segd n dog zĩig ninga. B yeel-⁠a lame tɩ Biiblã wilgame tɩ yaa Betlehɛm.

Rẽ poore, a Herood boola rap nins sẽn yi yaangã n yeel-⁠b yaa: ‘Bɩ y kẽng n tɩ bao biigã, la yãmb sã n yã-a bɩ y lebg n wa togs maam, tɩ mam me na n kẽng n tɩ waoog-⁠a lame.’ La a Herood yaool n da rat n bãnga biigã sẽn be zĩig ningã bal n tɩ kʋ-⁠a.

Rapã sẽn wa n yi Zerizalɛmmã, ãdg ning sẽn yãgdã ye pukame. Rapã pʋga ãdgã hal n tɩ ta Betlehɛm tɩ ãdgã tɩ yals biigã sẽn da be roog ning pʋgẽ wã zugu. Rapã sẽn kẽ roogẽ wã, b yãa a Maari ne a Zezi. B zãa kũun n wa kõ a Zezi. La rapã gũs n zãmsame, la zãmsdã pʋgẽ a Zeova yeel-⁠b lame tɩ b pa segd n lebg n kẽng a Herood nengẽ ye. Rẽ n so tɩ b tũ sor a to n leb bãmb tẽngẽ wã.

A Herood sẽn bãng tɩ rap nins sẽn yi yaangã lebg n kulame n pa tũ yẽ nengẽ wã, a sũurã puuga wʋsgo. A yeelame tɩ b tɩ kʋ kom-​dibli nins fãa sẽn be Betlehɛm n tar yʋʋm a yiib la sẽn ka ta woto wã. La a Zozɛf gãand n zãmsame, la zãmsdã pʋgẽ a Zeova yeel-⁠a lame t’a tall a pagã ne a biigã n zoe n kẽng Ezipti. A sɩd yika ne a zakã rãmb n kẽng be. Kaoosg poore, a Zozɛf sẽn wa n bãng t’a Herood kiime wã, a talla a Maari ne a Zezi n leb Nazarɛte. Yaa be la a Zezi bɩ-​yã.

Sã n yaa ne yãmba, ãnd n kɩt tɩ ãdgã puki? Tẽeg-⁠y tɩ rapã sẽn pʋg ãdgã, b reng n kẽnga Zerizalɛm. Yaa a Sʋɩtãan n da rat n kʋ Wẽnnaam biigã, la a ra miime tɩ Zerizalɛm rĩm a Herood me ra na n baoome n kʋ-⁠a. Rẽ n kɩt t’a maan tɩ ãdgã reng n kẽng Zerizalɛmmã. Dẽnd yaa a Sʋɩtãan n kɩt tɩ ãdgã pukã.Matɩe 2:​1-⁠23; Miise 5:⁠12, NW. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y bi-​riblã sẽn gomd ne kãsembã! Yaa Zerizalɛm wẽnd-​doogã karen-​saam dãmba. Bi-​riblã yaa a Zezi. A tara yʋʋm 12 masã.

A Zezi sẽn da mi Wẽnnaam sõma la a mi bũmb nins sẽn gʋls Biiblã pʋgẽ sõma wã yɛɛsa karen-​saam dãmbã. La a Zozɛf ne a Maari yẽ bee yɛ? Bɩ d gese.

Yʋʋmd fãa, a Zozɛf tallda a zaka rãmb n kẽngd Zerizalɛm tɩ b tɩ maan Pakã. Nazarɛt ra zãra ne Zerizalɛm wʋsgo. Bãmb wakatẽ wã tɩ mobil ne tẽr ka be ye. Nebã wʋsg ra kẽndame, la b rɩkda sẽn na n ta rasem a tãab n yaool n ta Zerizalɛm.

A Zozɛf zakã rãmb lebga wʋsgo. A Zezi ra tara yap sẽn ket n yaa kɩds tɩ b segd n ges b yelle. Rõandã wã, a Zozɛf ne a Maari kẽnga Zerizalɛm ne b kambã n lebg n kuusẽ. A Zezi ra ka be ne-⁠b ye. La b ra tagsdame t’a bee ne neb a taabã sẽn da naag-⁠b n togd sorã. La zaabrã sẽn wa n ta tɩ b yals n na n vʋʋsã, b kell n pa nee a Zezi ye. B soka b roagdbã la b zo-​rãmbã, la bãmb me yeelame tɩ b pa yã-a ye. Dẽnd a Zozɛf ne a Maari leba Zerizalɛm n na n tɩ gẽes a Zezi.

B wa n baas n yã-a lame t’a zĩ ne karen-​saam dãmbã. A ra kelgda b goamã la a sokd-⁠b sogsg wʋsgo. A Zezi bãngrã yɛɛsa neb nins fãa sẽn da kelgd-⁠a wã. La a Maari sẽn ta wã, a yeela a Zezi yaa: ‘M biiga, yaa bõe tɩ fo maan tõnd woto? Gese, maam ne f ba wã ra baooda foo zĩig fãa.’

La a Zezi leokame yaa: ‘Yaa bõe tɩ yãmb da baood maam? Yãmb ka mi tɩ mam segd n zĩnda m Ba roogẽ la?’

Vẽenega, a Zezi ra nong n bee zĩig ning a sẽn tõe n zãms n bãng Wẽnnaamã. Tõnd me segd n maana woto. A Zezi sẽn da be Nazarɛtã, rasem a yopoe fãa, a ra kẽnda zĩig ning nebã sẽn da tigimd taab n pʋʋsd a Zeova wã. A sẽn da kelgd neer wakat fãa wã yĩnga, a bãnga bũmb wʋsg Biiblã pʋgẽ. D rɩk a togs-⁠n-​taare.Luk 2:⁠41-⁠52; Matɩe 13:⁠53-⁠56. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y wall sẽn sigd a Zezi zugu. A Zezi tara yʋʋm pis-​tã masã. Rao ning sẽn yas koomã pʋgẽ ne-⁠a wã yaa a Zã. Tõnd zoe n goma a Zã yelle. Yãmb ket n tẽra a Maari sẽn wa n kẽng n tɩ ges a Elizabɛt tɩ biig ning sẽn da be a Elizabɛt pʋgẽ wã sũur yɩ noog t’a virsã bɩ? Biigã yaa a Zã. La bõe la a Zã ne a Zezi sẽn maand masã wã?

A Zã lisa a Zezi Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã pʋgẽ. Ned sã n na n deeg lisgu, b lisda a soabã koomã pʋgẽ, la b wẽneg n yiis-⁠a. A Zã sẽn da lisd nebã koomẽ wã yĩnga, b ra boond-⁠a lame t’a Zãmbatiisi. La bõe yĩng t’a Zã lis a Zezi?

Yaa a Zezi meng n wa n bõos a Zã t’a lis-⁠a. A Zã lisda neb nins sẽn dat n wilg Wẽnnaam tɩ b kota sugri, b sẽn maan yel-​wẽnã yĩnga. La a Zezi me maana yel-​wẽnd n dat n kos sugr bɩ? Ayo, a Zezi zɩ n maan yel-​wẽnd ye. Bala yaa Wẽnnaam meng biiga. Dẽnd yaa bũmb a to yĩng la a sẽn kos a Zã t’a lis-⁠a wã.

Nand t’a Zezi tɩ yã a Zã n bõos-⁠a t’a lis-⁠a, a ra yaa ra-​wãada. A ra maanda taabl dãmb ne goeelse. A Maari sɩd a Zozɛf n da zãms-⁠a, bala a ra yaa ra-​wãada. La a Zeova ra pa tʋm a bi-​riblã tẽng zug t’a wa yɩ ra-​wãad ye. A ra kõ-a-⁠la tʋʋmd a to. Wakat ra taame masã t’a Zezi segd n sɩng a tʋʋmdã. Dẽnd sẽn na yɩl n wilg nebã t’a na n sɩnga a ba wã sẽn tʋm-⁠a t’a wa maan bũmb ningã maaneg masã, a kosa a Zã t’a lis-⁠a. Wẽnnaam sũur yɩɩ noog bɩ? N-⁠ye, bala a Zezi sẽn puk koomẽ wã poore, koɛɛg n yi saasẽ n yeel yaa: ‘Ad-⁠a yaa mam Bi-​nongre, mam sẽn nong ne m sũur fãa.’ Sẽn paase, maana wa saasã pakame tɩ wall ning yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã sigd a Zezi zugu. La pa wall sɩd-​sɩd ye. Yaa Wẽnnaam vʋʋsem sõngã.

A Zezi lisgã poore, a kẽnga weoogẽ wã n tɩ pa be a yembr rasem pis-​naase, bala a da rat n tagsa bũmb wʋsg yelle. La a Sʋɩtãan wa n bʋʋg-⁠a-⁠la beenẽ. Naoor a tãabo, a Sʋɩtãan makame n na n kɩt t’a Zezi maan bũmb sẽn kɩɩsd Wẽnnaam noore, la a Zezi pa tol n sak ye.

Rẽ poore, a Zezi lebgame n kuusẽ n tek n seg neba, la nin-​kãens lebga a pipi karen-​biisi. Bãmb kẽer yʋy la woto: A Ãndere, a Pɩɛɛre (b sẽn boond me t’a Sɩmo), a Filipi, a Natanayɛlle (b sẽn boond me t’a Bartelemi). A Zezi ne a karen-⁠bi-​paalsã kẽnga Galile. B sẽn ta Galile wã, b kẽnga a Natanayɛll tẽngẽ wã Kana. Beenẽ, a Zezi kẽnga kãadem kibs a ye sẽn yɩ kãsenga. A maana a pipi yel-​solemdã beenẽ. Yãmb mii a sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ? A kɩtame tɩ koom lebg rãam.Matɩe 3:⁠13-⁠17; 4:​1-⁠11; 13:⁠55; Mark 6:⁠3; Zã 1:⁠29-⁠51; 2:​1-⁠12. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB sẽn get a Zezi foto kãngã zugã a sũurã ka puug sɩda? Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a sũurã puugã bɩ? Rap nins sẽn be wẽnd-​doogã pʋgẽ wã yaa neb sẽn nong ligd wʋsgo. B rat n wẽga neb nins sẽn wat n na n pʋʋs Wẽnnaamã n paam ligd wʋsgo.

Yãmb nee lolsã ne piisã la marwalã bɩ? Rapã koosda rũm-​kãensã wẽnd-​doogẽ wã. Yaa bõe yĩnga? Bala Israɛll nebã rata wal la rũms n maan maoong n kõ Wẽnnaam.

Wẽnnaam noor a ye n wilgd tɩ Israɛll ned sã n maan yel-​wẽnde, a segd n maana maoong n kõ Wẽnnaam n kos sugri. Israɛll nebã ra tara wakat a taab me n segd n maand maando. La yɛ la nebã ra tõe n paam rũms n maan maoong n kõ Wẽnnaam?

Israɛll neb kẽer n da gʋʋnd wal la rũmsi. Dẽnd bãmb ra tõe n yãka rẽ n maan maand n kõ Wẽnnaam. La neb wʋsg ra pa tar rũms ye. Kẽer me sẽn da vɩ zĩig ningã zãra wʋsg ne Zerizalɛm, tɩ b ka tõe n tall b rũmsã hal be n wa Zerizalɛm ye. Yaa rẽ yĩng la nebã sẽn da wat wẽnd-​doogẽ wã n daad rũmsã. La rapã ra koosda b rũmsã toogo. B ra wẽgda nebã. Sẽn paas menga, b ra pa segd n koosd wẽnd-​doogẽ wã ye.

Yaa rẽ n puug a Zezi sũurã. Rẽ n so t’a tus rapã taabl dãmb n lubi, n sãeeg b ligdã tẽnga. A rɩka wĩ n maan kalwaas n dig rũmsã fãa n yiis wẽnd-​doogẽ wã. A yeela neb nins sẽn da koosd marwalã yaa: ‘Yiis-⁠y bõn-​kãensã ka. Da maan-⁠y mam Ba wã roog tɩ lebg teed koosg zĩig ye.’

A Zezi karen-​biis kẽer n da tũud-⁠a. B sẽn yã a sẽn maan bũmb ningã ling-⁠b lame. La b tẽega Biiblã sẽn gomd Wẽnnaam bi-​riblã yell n yet tɩ ‘Wẽnnaam doogã nonglem na n soog-⁠a-⁠la zãngã.’

A Zezi sẽn wa Zerizalɛm n na n maan Pakã, a maana yel-​soalem wʋsg me. Rẽ poore, a yii Zide n na n leb Galile. La a tek n yalsa Samari. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn maan be.Zã 2:⁠13-⁠25; 4:​3, 4. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZEZI yalsa Samari bulg noor n na n vʋʋse. A karen-​biisã kẽe tẽngã pʋgẽ n na n bao rɩɩbo. Pag ning a Zezi sẽn gomd ne wã waame n na n wi koom. A Zezi yeela pagã yaa: ‘M kota koom n na n yũ.’

La linga pagã wʋsgo. Yãmb mii sẽn yaa bũmb ning yĩng bɩ? Yaa a Zezi sẽn yaa Zʋɩf tɩ yẽ yaa Samari nedã yĩnga. Zʋɩf rãmbã ra kisa Samari nebã. B ra pʋd n pa gomd ne-⁠b meng ye. La a Zezi nonga nebã fãa. A yeela pagã yaa: ‘Fo sã n da mi ned ninga sẽn yet foo tɩ f kõ-a koom t’a yũ wã, fo ra na n kosa yẽ t’a kõ-f koom sẽn kõt vɩɩm.’

La pagã yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘M kẽema, bulgã zulmame, la yãmb ka tar bũmb sẽn na n wi koomã ye. Zĩ-bʋg la yãmb na n paam ko-​kãng sẽn kõt vɩɩmã?’

A Zezi leok-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Fo sã n yũ bul-​kãngã koom, ko-​yũud na n le yõka foo. La ned sã n yũ koom ningã mam sẽn na n kõ yẽ wã, a tõe n kɩtame t’a soab vɩɩmd wakat sẽn ka sate.’

Tɩ pagã yeel a Zezi yaa: ‘M kẽema, bɩ y kõ maam ko-​kãng tɩ m yũ, tɩ ko-​yũud ra le tol n yõk-⁠ma, la m da le wat n wiid koom ka ye.’

Pagã ra tẽedame t’a Zezi gomda koom sɩd-​sɩd yelle. La a Zezi ra gomda Wẽnnaam ne a rĩungã bãngr yelle. Bãng-​kãng wõnda koom sẽn kõt vɩɩm, bala a kɩtdame tɩ ned paam vɩɩm sẽn ka sate.

A Zezi yeela pagã yaa: ‘Kẽng n tɩ bool f sɩdã t’a wa ka.’

La pagã yeelame t’a pa tar sɩd ye.

A Zezi yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Fo togsa sɩda, bala fo talla sɩdb a nu, la fo sẽn be ne a soab masã wa ka fo sɩd ye.’

Woto linga pagã, bala a Zezi sẽn yeelã fãa yaa sɩda. La a Zezi maana wãn n bãng rẽ fãa? Yaa Wẽnnaam n tʋm a Zezi tẽngã zugu, la yaa yẽ n wilg-⁠a rẽ fãa. A Zezi karen-​biisã sẽn yi tẽngã pʋgẽ n lebg n wa mik t’a gomd ne Samari pagã, ling-⁠b lame.

Woto fãa wilgda tõnd bõe? T’a Zezi nonga nebã fãa. Tõnd me segd n nonga nebã fãa. Tõnd pa segd n yãk buud a ye neb n yet tɩ b pa sõma ye. A Zezi ratame tɩ nebã fãa bãng Wẽnnaam n wa paam vɩɩm sẽn ka satã. Tõnd me segd n sõnga nebã tɩ b bãng Wẽnnaam.Zã 4:​5-⁠43; 17:⁠3. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZEZI zĩi Galile tãng a ye zug n zãmsd nebã. Neb nins sẽn zĩ a sɛɛgẽ wã yaa a karen-​biisi. A yãka bãmb 12 b sʋk n boond t’a tʋm-​tʋmdba. Yãmb mii a tʋm-​tʋmdbã yʋy bɩ?

Yaa a Sɩmo Pɩɛɛr ne a ma-​biig a Ãndere, a Zak ne a ma-​biig a Zã. Tʋm-​tʋmd a to me n be t’a yʋʋr yaa a Zake, t’a to me yʋʋr yaa a Sɩmo. Zida rãmbã me ra yaa b yiibu. A ye wã yaa a Zida Iskariote, la b boonda Zida a to wã t’a Taade. Sẽn kell-​bã yaa a Filipi, a Natanayɛlle, a Matɩe, la a Toma. A Natanayɛll yʋʋr a to me la a Bartelemi.

A Zezi sẽn yi Samari n ta Galile wã, a sɩngame n moondẽ n yetẽ tɩ saasẽ rĩungã kolgame. Yãmb mii saasẽ rĩungã sẽn yaa bũmb ning bɩ? Yaa Wẽnnaam goosneema. Wẽnnaam yãka a Zezi t’a yaa a goosneema wã naaba. A na n zĩnda saasẽ n dɩ naam tẽngã zugu, n kɩt tɩ laafɩ zĩndi. Wẽnnaam rĩungã na n kɩtame tɩ tẽngã fãa lebg arzãna.

A Zezi zĩ n gomda Wẽnnaam rĩungã yell ne nebã. A yeela nebã tɩ b pʋʋs woto: ‘Tõnd Ba sẽn be saasẽ, bɩ f yʋʋrã yɩ ne waoogre. Bɩ f soolem wa, tɩ f raabã maan dũniyã zug wa sẽn maand saasẽ wã.’ Neb wʋsg boonda pʋʋs-​kãngã tɩ ‘Tõnd Ba sẽn be saasẽ wã’ pʋʋsgo. Yãmb mii pʋʋsgã ne zug bɩ? A Zezi leb n wilga ned kam fãa sẽn segd n maan bũmb ninga. A yeelame yaa: ‘Yãmb sẽn dat tɩ nebã maan yãmb bũmb ningã, bɩ yãmb me maan bãmb woto.’ Neb a taabã sã n maand yãmb neere, pa noom yãmb sɩda? Dẽnd a Zezi rat n wilgame tɩ d segd n maana neb a taabã me neere. Nebã fãa sẽn na n wa maand woto arzãnã pʋgẽ wã na n kɩtame tɩ vɩɩmã yɩ noogo. Ka sɩda?Matɩe sak a 5 n tɩ tãag a 7; 10:​1-⁠4. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

BI-​PUGL ning yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã tara yʋʋm 12. Yaa a Zezi la sẽn gãd a nugã. A ba wã ne a ma wã la sẽn yas be wã. B sũyã yaa noogo. Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b sũyã noomẽ wã bɩ?

Bi-​puglã ba wã yʋʋr la a Zairus. A yaa nin-​kãsenga. Daar a yembre, bãag n yõk biigã. A bãagã ra pa sãoogd ye. Ra tara kengr bala. A Zairus ne a pagã ra yɛɛsdame, bala wõnda b biigã rat n kiime. Yaool n yaa b bi-​pugl-yende. Rẽ n kɩt t’a Zairus kẽng n na n tɩ bao a Zezi, bala a wʋmame t’a Zezi maanda yel-​soalma.

A Zairus sẽn wa n yã a Zezi wã, rẽ tɩ neb wʋsg n gũbg-⁠a n wẽdgd taaba. La a Zairus wẽdga nebã n ta a Zezi nengẽ n wõgemd a taoor n yeel yaa: ‘Mam bi-​puglã yĩnsã zabda wʋsgo. Maan sugr la f wa sãoog a bãagã.’ A Zezi yeelame t’a na n tɩ sãooga biigã bãagã.

B sẽn wa n debd a Zairus yirã, nebã ra ket n wẽdgda taaba. Zĩig pʋgẽ bala a Zezi bãngame tɩ ned n sɩɩs-⁠a, bala a pãngã booga bilfu, t’a sok tɩ: ‘Ãnd n sɩɩs maam?’ La yaa ãnd la sẽn sɩɩs-⁠a wã? Yaa pag a ye sẽn da bẽed hal yʋʋm 12. A kolgame n sɩɩs a Zezi fuugã t’a bãagã sãooge.

A Zairus sẽn yã rẽ wã a sũurã yɩɩ noogo, bala a bãngame t’a Zezi tõe n sãooga ned tao-​tao. La ned la b tʋm t’a wa yeel a Zairus yaa: ‘Ra le nams-⁠y a Zezi ye. Yãmb bi-​puglã kiime.’ A Zezi sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, a yeela a Zairus yaa: ‘Da zoe rabeem ye, biigã na n vʋʋgame.’

B sẽn tɩ ta a Zairus zakẽ wã, b mikame tɩ nebã yãbd la b wiisdẽ. La a Zezi yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Ra yãb-⁠y ye. Biigã pa ki ye, a gõeeme.’ La nebã laame la b yaal a Zezi, bala b ra miime tɩ biigã sɩd kiime.

A Zezi peega biigã ba ne a ma, n paas a tʋm-​tʋmdb a tãab n kẽ b sẽn da gãneg biigã roog ningã pʋgẽ. A gãda biigã nug n yeel yaa: ‘Biiga, yiki!’ Wa yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã, biigã sɩd vʋʋgame n yiki. A sẽn yikã, a sɩnga kẽn menga. Yaa rẽ yĩng la a ba wã ne a ma wã sũurã sẽn noom wʋsgã.

Pa pipi la woto a Zezi sẽn vʋʋg kũum ye. Biiblã wilgame t’a Zezi sẽn vʋʋg ned ning pipi yɩɩ Nayin pʋg-​kõor bi-​ribla. A Zezi vʋʋga a Lazaar sẽn yaa a Mart ne a Maari tão wã me. A Zezi naamã rɩɩb wakate, a na n vʋʋga neb wʋsgo. Woto pa kiba-​noog sɩda?Luk 8:⁠40-⁠56; 7:⁠11-⁠17; Zã 11:⁠17-⁠44. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YEL-​BEED n maane. B kʋʋ a Zãmbatiisi. Rĩm a Herood pag a Herodiaad ra pa nong a Zãmbatiis ye. A maana a sẽn tõe fãa tɩ rĩmã kɩt tɩ b fiuug a Zã zugã.

A Zezi sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, a sũurã sãama wʋsg t’a kẽng weoogẽ wã n tɩ zĩ be a yembre. La neb kʋʋng bʋʋg-​a–la be. A Zezi sẽn yã kʋʋngã, b nimbãanegã yõk-⁠a lame t’a gom Wẽnnaam rĩungã yell ne-⁠b la a sãoog bãad dãmbã.

Zĩ-sobd sẽn wa n ta, a Zezi karen-​biisã kolgame n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Zĩ-kãngã yaa weoogo, la zĩigã zoe n zʋʋgame. Bɩ f bas nebã tɩ b loog n kẽng tẽnsã pʋsẽ n tɩ ra rɩɩbo.’

La a Zezi yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Ka tɩlae tɩ b loog ye. Bɩ yãmb mens bao rɩɩb n kõ-b tɩ b rɩ.’ A Zezi wẽnegame n sok a Filip yaa: ‘Yɛ la d tõe n da rɩɩb tɩ sek nin-​kãensã fãa?’

La a Filip leokame yaa: ‘Tõnd sã n dat n da rɩɩb tɩ ned kam fãa tõog n paam baa yaa bilf menga, rẽndame tɩ d yiis ligd wʋsgo.’ T’a Ãndere yeel yaa: ‘Biig n be ka n tar bur a nu ne zĩm a yiib bala. La pa tõe n sek nebã fãa ye.’

La a Zezi yeelame tɩ b kɩt tɩ nebã zĩnd moodẽ wã. A pʋʋsa Wẽnnaam, la a sɩng burã kaoobo. Rẽ poore, a karen-​biisã pʋɩya burã ne zĩmã tɩ nebã fãa paame. Nebã ra yaa rap tus a nu, la pagb ne kamb wʋsgo. B fãa rɩɩme n tɩge, la karen-​biisã wʋka rɩ-​kɛlã n pids pet 12!

A Zezi kɩtame t’a karen-​biisã kẽ koom koglg n na n dʋʋg Galile mogrã. La seb-​kẽeng n yik ne yʋngã tɩ mogrã koom lengd koglgã, tɩ karen-​biisã yɛɛse. Yʋn-​sʋkã sẽn ta, b wa n nee ned sẽn kẽnd koomã zug n watẽ. B sẽn da ka mi sẽn yaa ned ningã yĩnga, b yɛɛsame n kelme.

La a Zezi yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Da zoe-⁠y rabeem ye. Yaa maam.’ La b ket n da pa tẽed ye. Rẽ n so t’a Pɩɛɛr yeel yaa: ‘Zusoaba, sã n sɩd yaa foo, bɩ f kõ maam noor tɩ m kẽn koomã zug n wa fo nengẽ.’ A Zezi yeel-⁠a lame t’a wa. A Pɩɛɛr sɩd yii koglgẽ wã n sɩng koomã zug kẽna. La a wa n yɛɛsame n sɩng bõrbo, t’a Zezi fãag-⁠a.

Daar a to me, a Zezi kõo neb tusa rɩɩb tɩ b rɩ. Baraarã yɩɩ ne bur a yopoe ne zĩm bõones a wãn bala. La seka nebã fãa. A Zezi sẽn da get nebã yell to-⁠to wã pa noom-⁠d sɩda? A sã n wa rɩt a naamã, baa fʋɩ pa na n paoog-⁠d ye.Matɩe 14:​1-⁠32; 15:⁠29-⁠38; Zã 6:​1-⁠21. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y a Zezi sẽn mobg biigã. Wilgdame t’a nonga kambã. Rap nins sẽn yas n getẽ wã yaa a tʋm-​tʋmdbã. A Zezi yet-⁠b lame tɩ bõe?

A Zezi ne a tʋm-​tʋmdbã ra toga so-​wok n lebg n wa. B sẽn da wa n be sorã zugã, tʋm-​tʋmdbã ra wẽeda no-​koɛɛma. Dẽnd b sẽn wa n ta wã, a Zezi sok-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Yaa bõe poorẽ la yãmb sẽn da wẽed no-​koeemd ne taab sorã zugã?’ A Zezi yaool n da miime, la a sokame n na n ges a tʋm-​tʋmdbã sã n na n sak n togs-⁠a lame.

La tʋm-​tʋmdbã pa sak n na n togs-⁠a ye. Bala b ra wẽeda no-​koeemd n dat n bãng ned ning sẽn yaa kãseng n yɩɩd bãmb sʋkã. Tʋm-​tʋmdb kẽer da ratame tɩ b yeel tɩ b taabã sʋka bãmb n yɩɩde. La wãn to la a Zezi ra na n wilg-⁠b tɩ pa sõma tɩ b bao n yɩɩg b taabã?

A boola biigã n kɩt t’a yals a tʋm-​tʋmdbã fãa taoore, la a yaool n yeel-⁠b woto: ‘Mam yeta yãmb tɩ y sã n ka tek yam n lebg wa kom-​bõonego, yãmb ka na n kẽ Wẽnnaam rĩungã pʋgẽ ye. Ned ninga fãa sẽn na n sik a meng wa bi-​kãngã, a na n yɩɩ kãseng n yɩɩd Wẽnnaam rĩungã pʋgẽ.’ Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Zezi yet woto wã bɩ?

Bala kom-​bõonegã ka baood n na n yɩɩg b taabã ye. Dẽnd a Zezi tʋm-​tʋmdbã ra segd n yɩɩ wa kom-​bõonego, n da wẽed no-​koɛɛm n dat n bãng ned ning sẽn yaa kãseng n yɩɩd a taabã fãa ye.

A Zezi wilga sasa a taab me t’a nonga kambã. Wala makre, kiis a wãn poore, neb n tall b kamb n wa a nengẽ. Tʋm-​tʋmdbã makame n na n gɩdg-⁠ba, la a Zezi yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Bas-⁠y kom-​bõonegã tɩ b wa mam nengẽ la y ra gɩdg-⁠b ye. Bala Wẽnnaam rĩungã yaa neb nins sẽn wẽnd bãmbã yĩnga.’ Rẽ poore, a Zezi reega kambã n ning-⁠b barka. Tõnd sẽn mi t’a Zezi nonga kambã noom-⁠d-⁠la wʋsgo. Ka sɩda?Matɩe 18:​1-⁠4; 19:⁠13-⁠15; Mark 9:⁠33-⁠37; 10:⁠13-⁠16. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

data.titulo: A Zezi sẽn zãms nebã to-to
data.contenido:
DAAR a yembre, a Zezi yeela rao a ye t’a segd n nonga a taabã. La raoã soka a Zezi tɩ ãnd n yaa yẽ to? A Zezi ra mii raoã sẽn tagsd bũmb ninga. A ra tagsdame tɩ yaa yẽ buudã neb ne a tũudmã neb bal la a segd n nongẽ. La d ges a Zezi sẽn yeel raoã bũmb ninga.

Wakat ninga, a Zezi sã n dat n zãms neba bũmbu, a tũnugda ne kibare. Dẽnd a na n togsa raoã kibar t’a bãng sẽn yaa ned ning la yẽ to. Kibarã gomda Samari rao ne Zʋɩf a ye yelle. Tõnd ra zoe n yãa poorẽ wã tɩ Zʋɩf rãmbã wʋsg ra kisa Samari nebã. La kelg-⁠y kibar ning a Zezi sẽn togsã:

Daar a yembre, Zʋɩf a ye n yi Zerizalɛm n dabd Zeriko, tɩ fãadb tek n yõk-⁠a n deeg a ligdã fãa la b pãb-⁠a t’a rat n ki tɩ b bas-⁠a sorã zug la b looge.

La Zʋɩf rãmbã maan-​kʋʋd a ye n wa n loogdẽ, n yã rao ning wagda wã sẽn pãbã. Yãmb mii a sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ? A bʋdgame n looge. Zʋɩf rãmbã tũudmã taoor soab a to me n wa n loogd so-​kãng zugu. Yaa Levi neda. A yalsame bɩ? Ayo, yẽ me pa yals n na n sõng rao ning b sẽn pãbã ye. Ges-⁠y fotã zug tɩ y na yã maan-​kʋʋdã ne Levi nedã sẽn loogde.

La yãmb mii ned ning sẽn yals n sõngd raoã bɩ? Yaa Samari neda. Rao ning wagda wã sẽn pãbã yaool n da yaa Zʋɩf. La Samari nedã tɩbsa Zʋɩfã noadã, la rẽ poore a tall-⁠a lame n kẽng sik-​zĩigẽ t’a na n vʋʋse, la a tɩp n baase.

A Zezi sẽn togs kibarã n sa, a soka ned ning sẽn da sok-⁠a wã yaa: ‘Sã n yaa ne foo, neb a tãabã sʋka, ãnda n yaa ned ning wagda wã sẽn pãbã to? Yaa maan-​kʋʋdã bɩ, Levi nedã bɩ, bɩ yaa Samari nedã?’

Raoã leokame tɩ yaa Samari nedã, bala yaa yẽ n ges raoã yelle.

A Zezi yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Yaa sɩda. Bɩ fo me kẽng n tɩ maan woto.’

A Zezi sẽn da zãmsd nebã to-⁠to wã pa noom yãmb sɩda? Tõnd sã n karemd a Zezi sẽn yeel bũmb ning Biiblã pʋgẽ wã, d na n bãnga bũmb wʋsgo.Luk 10:⁠25-⁠37. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZEZI sẽn wa n gilgd zĩig fãa wã, a ra sãoogda bãad dãmba. Nebã ra togsda zĩig fãa t’a Zezi sãoogda bãad dãmba. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ nebã ra talld põeyã, zoense, mugs la bãad dãmb a taab n wat a Zezi nengẽ t’a sãoogd-⁠ba.

A Zã sẽn lis a Zezi wã yɩɩda yʋʋm a tãab masã. A Zezi yeela a tʋm-​tʋmdbã tɩ ka la bilfu, yẽ na n kẽnga Zerizalɛm la b na n tɩ kʋʋ yẽ beenẽ, la tɩ rẽ poore a na n lebg n vʋʋgame. La nand t’a kũumã daar ta, a ra ket n gilgdame la a sãoogd bãad dãmbã.

Daar a yembre, a Zezi zãmsa nebã vʋʋsg daare. Vʋʋsg daarã yaa daar Zʋɩf rãmbã sẽn da pa segd n tʋme. Pag ning yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã bẽedame. Yʋʋm 18 masã la a sẽn zõr n pa tõe n doog a mengã. La a Zezi sɩɩs-⁠a lame, t’a sãoog n tõe n doog masã.

La tũudmã taoor dãmb sũur puugame tɩ b ned a ye yeel nebã yaa: ‘Rasem a yoob n be tõnd sẽn tõe n tʋme. Bɩ y wa ra-​kãens n wa paam maagre, la y ra le wa vʋʋsg daar ye.’

La a Zezi yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Yãmb yaa nin-​wẽnse. Rẽ yĩnga yãmb ka lokd y bõens n kẽnd n yũnugd koom vʋʋsg daar sɩda? La pʋg-​kãngã sẽn yaa nimbãan-​ned n bẽed hal yʋʋm piig la a nii wã la yãmb yeel tɩ b ra sãoog vʋʋsg daare?’ A Zezi sẽn gom woto wã kɩtame tɩ yãnd yõk-⁠ba.

Rẽ poore, a Zezi ne a tʋm-​tʋmdbã yikame n na n kẽng Zerizalɛm. B sẽn yi Zeriko tẽngã bala, zoens a yiib sẽn yaa bõos rãmb n wʋm t’a Zezi ra loogdame tɩ b zẽk b koees n yeel yaa: ‘Zezi, sõng tõndo.’

A Zezi boola zoensã kɛɛng n sok-⁠b yaa: ‘Bõe la yãmb dat tɩ m maan n kõ-yã?’ Zoensã leokame yaa: ‘Zusoaba, maan sugr la f kɩt tɩ d ninã puki.’ A Zezi sɩɩsa b ninã, la b ninã puka zĩig pʋgẽ tɩ b ne masã. Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Zezi maan yel-​solem kãensã fãa wã bɩ? Yaa a sẽn nong nebã la a rat tɩ b tẽ-a wã yĩnga. Sẽn paase, kɩtame tɩ d bãng t’a sã n wa rɩt a naamã, ned baa a ye pa na n le bẽ ye.Matɩe 15:⁠30, 31; Luk 13:⁠10-⁠17; Matɩe 20:⁠29-⁠34. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZEZI sẽn puk zoens a yiibã sẽn yaa bõos rãmbã ninã poor bilfu, a kẽnga tẽng-​bil a ye sẽn pẽ Zerizalɛm. A sẽn ta wã, a yeela a karen-​biis a yiib woto: ‘Kẽ-y tẽngã pʋgẽ tɩ y na n yãa bõn-​bil b sẽn loe. Lok-⁠y-​yã n wa kõ maam.’

Karen-​biisã tɩ talla bõangã n wa t’a Zezi zomb-⁠a n na n kẽng Zerizalɛm sẽn da pa le zãrã. A sẽn wa n kolgd Zerizalɛmmã, neb wʋsg n yi n na n seg-⁠a. Bãmb wʋsg yeesa b futã n tɩʋ sorã zugu, tɩ kẽer kaood koms vãad n dɩgend sorã zug la b yetẽ yaa: ‘Bark bee rĩm ning sẽn wat a Zeova yʋʋr yĩngã zugu!’

Pĩndã, Israɛll tẽngẽ wã, rĩm-paalg ra segd n zomba bõn-​bil n kẽ Zerizalɛm n wilg nebã fãa tɩ yẽ n lebg rĩmã. Yaa rẽ la a Zezi sẽn maanã. Neb nins yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã me wilgdame tɩ b ratame t’a Zezi yɩ b rĩma. La pa nebã fãa n sak ye. D ges bũmb ning sẽn maane, a Zezi sẽn wa n ta wẽnd-​doogẽ wã.

Wẽnd-​doogẽ wã, a sãooga koms rãmb la a puk zoens nini. Kambã sẽn yã rẽ wã, b zẽka b koees n pẽgd a Zezi. La maan-​kʋʋdbã sũy puugame tɩ b yeel a Zezi yaa: ‘Fo wʋmda kambã sẽn yetã bɩ?’

A Zezi leok-⁠b lame tɩ: ‘N-⁠ye, yãmb nan ka karem Biiblã pʋgẽ tɩ b yetẽ tɩ: “Wẽnnaam paama pẽgr sẽn yit kom-​bõoneg noyẽ la?” ’ Kambã kell n pẽga rĩm ning Wẽnnaam sẽn yãkã.

Tõnd fãa me segd n maana wa kom-​kãensã. Neb kẽer tõe n makame n na n gɩdg tõnd tɩ d ra gom Wẽnnaam rĩungã yell ye. La tõnd na n ket n gomda bõn-​sõma nins a Zezi sẽn na n wa maanã yelle.

Pa a Zezi sẽn wa n be tẽngã zugã la a sɩng a naamã rɩɩb ye. Yãmb mii sẽn yɩ wakat ning bɩ? A karen-​biisã ra sok-⁠a lame n dat n bãnge. D na n yãa rẽ kibar ning sẽn pʋgdã pʋgẽ.Matɩe 21:​1-⁠17; Zã 12:⁠12-⁠16. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZEZI bee Oliiv tɩɩs tãngã zugu. Rap a naas nins sẽn be ne-⁠a wã yaa a tʋm-​tʋmdba. Yaa a Ãndere ne a ma-​biig a Pɩɛɛre, la a Zak ne a ma-​biig a Zã. Roog ning yãmb sẽn ne yɩɩgã yaa Zerizalɛm wẽnd-​doogã.

A Zezi sẽn zomb bõn-​bilã n kẽ Zerizalɛmmã taa rasem a yiibu. La yaa talaat daar masã. Yibeoogã, a Zezi ra bee wẽnd-​doogẽ wã. Maan-​kʋʋdbã da rat n yõk-⁠a lame n kʋ, la b yɛɛsdame bala nebã ra nonga a Zezi.

A Zezi yeelame tɩ maan-​kʋʋdbã yaa wa wiis la wag-​toos buudu, la tɩ Wẽnnaam na n sɩbg-⁠b-⁠la b tʋʋm-​wẽnsã yĩnga. Rẽ poore, a Zezi kẽngame n tɩ rʋ Oliiv tɩɩs tãngã zugu, t’a tʋm-​tʋmdb a naasã bʋʋg-⁠a be n na n sok-⁠a bũmbu. Yãmb mii b sẽn sok a Zezi bũmb ning bɩ?

Tʋm-​tʋmdbã da rat n bãnga bũmb nins sẽn na n zĩnd beoog daare. B ra miime t’a Zezi na n wa kɩtame tɩ wẽnemã fãa sa. La b da rat n bãnga sẽn na n wa yɩ wakat ninga. Wakat bʋg la a Zezi ra tog n sɩng a naamã rɩɩbo?

A Zezi ra miime t’a sã n wa na n sɩng a naamã rɩɩbo, a karen-​biis nins sẽn na n be-⁠b tẽng zug wakat kãngã wã ra pa na n yã-a ye. Bala a na n dɩɩ a naamã saasẽ. Rẽ n so t’a wilg a tʋm-​tʋmdbã yɛl kẽer sẽn na n maan tẽngã zugu, a sã n wa rɩt a naamã saasẽ. Yel-​kãens la bʋse?

A Zezi yeelame tɩ zab-​bɛd n na n zĩndi, tɩ bãas la kom na n yõka neb wʋsgo, tɩ nebã na n maana tʋʋm-​beed wʋsgo, la tɩ tẽn-​digimdgã me na n zĩnda zĩis wʋsgo. A Zezi leb n yeelame tɩ Wẽnnaam rĩungã koe-​noog na n moona dũniyã gill zugu. Tõnd nee woto fãa rũndã-rũndã bɩ? N-⁠ye! Dẽnd d tõe n kɩsa sɩd t’a Zezi rɩta naam saasẽ masã. Ka la bilfu, a na n kɩtame tɩ wẽnemã fãa sa tẽngã zugu.Matɩe 21:⁠46; 23:​1-⁠39; 24:​1-⁠14; Mark 13:​3-⁠10. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZEZI ne a tʋm-​tʋmdb 12 wã bee ro-​bedr pʋgẽ n na n dɩ Pakã rɩɩbo. Yaa lamusã daar yʋngo. Rao ning sẽn yitã yaa a Zida Iskariot. A rebd n na n tɩ wilga maan-​kʋʋdbã b sẽn tõe n paam a Zezi zĩig ning n yõke.

Arbã daar mengã, a Zida tɩ sok-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Mam sã n sõng yãmb tɩ y yõk a Zezi, yãmb na n kõo maam bõe?’ B leok-⁠a lame tɩ b na n kõ-a-⁠la wanzuri ligd pis-​tã. Rẽ n kɩt t’a Zida rebd b nengẽ n na n tɩ peeg-⁠b tɩ b wa yõk a Zezi. Ad yaa wẽnem menga!

A Zezi ne a tʋm-​tʋmdbã rɩɩ Pakã rɩɩb n sa masã. La a Zezi sɩnga kibs a to. A rɩka bur n kõ a tʋm-​tʋmdbã n yeel-⁠b yaa: ‘Bɩ y reeg n dɩ, bala yãoã makda mam yĩngã mam sẽn na n kõ yãmbã.’ A rɩka divẽ me n kõ-b n yeel yaa: ‘Bɩ y reeg n yũ, bala yãoã makda mam zɩɩmã sẽn na n daag yãmb yĩngã.’ Biiblã pʋgẽ, b boonda a Zezi sẽn maanã tɩ ‘Zusoabã kũum tẽegre,’ bɩ ‘Soaalã rɩɩbo.’

Israɛll nebã ra maanda Pakã kibs n tẽegd Wẽnnaam malɛkã sẽn da pa kʋ bãmb kambã n yaool n kʋ Ezipt nebã kom-​dẽemsã yelle. La masã, a Zezi ratame t’a karen-​biisã tẽegd a yelle, la b tẽegd a sẽn ki bãmb yĩngã me yelle. Yaa rẽ yĩng la a sẽn yeel-⁠b tɩ b maand yẽ kũumã tẽegr yʋʋmd fãa wã.

Rẽ poore, a Zezi yeela a tʋm-​tʋmdbã tɩ b tẽ Wẽnnaam ne b sũyã fãa la b ra zoe rabeem ye. B yɩɩla yɩɩl n pẽg Wẽnnaam n yaool n yi. Zĩigã ra zʋʋga wʋsgo. Bɩ d ges b sẽn na n kẽng zĩig ning masã.Matɩe 26:⁠14-⁠30; Luk 22:​1-⁠39; Zã sak 13 n tɩ tãag 17; 1 Korẽnt dãmba 11:⁠20. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZEZI ne a tʋm-​tʋmdbã sẽn yi roogẽ wã poore, b kẽnga Gɛtsemane tɩɩsã zĩigẽ. B ra zoe n kẽnga be naoor wʋsgo. B sẽn ta wã, a Zezi yeel-⁠b lame tɩ b yals ka n pʋʋs la b ra gũs ye. Yẽ mengã zãaga bilf n tɩ yĩgimd n fõgen a neng tẽng n pʋʋsdẽ.

Wakat a wãn poore, a lebg n waa a tʋm-​tʋmdbã nengẽ. Yãmb mii b sẽn da maand bũmb ning bɩ? B ra gõeeme! A Zezi yaool n da yeel-⁠b-⁠la naoor a tãab tõr tɩ b ra gũs ye. A sã n tɩ pʋʋs n lebg n wa fãa, a mikdame tɩ b gõeeme. La naoor a tãab-⁠n-​soabã, a Zezi yeel-⁠b-⁠la woto: ‘Yaa bõe tɩ yãmb gõeyã? Mam bɛɛbã na n yõka maam masã.’

Wakat kãng bala, b wʋma neb wʋsg rãamde. B yãa rap sẽn zãad sʋʋs ne kãn la b zãad bugum n watẽ. B sẽn wa n kolgã, nin-⁠yend n yi nebã sʋk n ta a Zezi taoor n mok-⁠a. Yaa a Zida Iskariote. Yãmb pa ne-⁠a fotã zug sɩda? La bõe yĩng t’a Zida ta n mok a Zezi?

A Zezi sok-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Zida, fo zãmbda maam ne mokr la?’ A Zida ra yeela rapã tɩ yaa ned ning yẽ sẽn na n mokã la a Zezi. A Zezi bɛɛbã kolgame n na n yõk-⁠a, la a Pɩɛɛr ra pa rat n sak tɩ b yõk a Zezi faag-​faag ye. A wõoga a sʋʋgã n na n kɛ rao ning sẽn da yas a sɛɛgẽ wã. La sʋʋgã ka paam raoã zug ye, yaa a rɩtg tʋbrã la a fiuug-​yã. La a Zezi sɩɩsa raoã tʋbr tɩ maage.

Rẽ poore a Zezi yeela a Pɩɛɛr yaa: ‘Sui f sʋʋgã a wʋʋgẽ. Fo ka mi tɩ mam tõe n bõosa m Ba t’a kɩt tɩ malɛgs wʋsg wa sõng maam la?’ Vẽenega, a Zezi ra tõe n pʋʋsa a Ba wã n bõos sõngre. La a Zezi ka maan woto, bala a miime t’a bɛɛbã segd n yõk-⁠a lame masã. Rẽ n so t’a bas tɩ b yõk-⁠a n tall n looge. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn na n paam a Zezi masã.Matɩe 26:⁠36-⁠56; Luk 22:⁠39-⁠53; Zã 18:​1-⁠12. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y yel-​beed ning sẽn paam a Zezi wã! B ka-⁠a-⁠la raoog zugu. B kaa a nusã ne a naoã ne põent rãmba. A na n kiime. La bõe yĩng tɩ b namsd a Zezi woto?

Bala neb n kis a Zezi. Yãmb mii sẽn yaa neb nins bɩ? A Sʋɩtãan la pipi soabã. Yaa yẽ la malɛg-​wẽng ning sẽn kɩt t’a Ãdem ne a Hawa kɩɩs a Zeova noorã. Leb n yaa yẽ n kɩt t’a Zezi bɛɛbã namsd-⁠a woto wã.

Nand t’a Zezi bɛɛbã ka-⁠a raoogã zugu, b nams-⁠a lame. Yãmb ket n tẽra b sẽn wa Gɛtsemane tɩɩsã zĩigẽ n yõk a Zezi n tall n loogã bɩ? Yɩɩ ãnd dãmba? Ra yaa tũudmã taoor dãmba. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn maan rẽ poore.

Tũudmã taoor dãmb sẽn yõk a Zezi wã poore, a tʋm-​tʋmdbã yɛɛsame n zoe n bas-⁠a a yembr ne a bɛɛbã. La tʋm-​tʋmd a Pɩɛɛr ne a Zã pa zoe n zãag ye. B ra pʋgda yɩɩg-​yɩɩg n na n ges bũmb ning sẽn na n paam a Zezi.

Maan-​kʋʋdbã talla a Zezi n kẽng pĩnd maan-​kʋʋdb kãsem a Ann nengẽ. La b pa kaoos be ye. B tall-⁠a lame n kẽng a Kayɩf sẽn da yaa maan-​kʋʋdbã kãsem wakat kãngã wã me nengẽ. Tũudmã taoor dãmb wʋsg n da tigim taab be.

B bʋʋ a Zezi a Kayɩf zakẽ wã. B talla neb tɩ b wa rõd-⁠a. Tũudmã taoor dãmb fãa yeelame t’a Zezi segda ne kũum. B tʋbsa a nengã kolkood la b pãb-⁠a ne nug-​gila.

Wakat kãng t’a Pɩɛɛr da bee zakã pʋgẽ. Waooda yĩnga, nebã ra widga bugum n wootẽ. La tʋm-​tʋm-​poak a yembr n yã a Pɩɛɛr n yeel yaa: ‘Ra-​kãngã me ra bee ne a Zezi.’

La a Pɩɛɛr kɩɩsame tɩ yẽ ka mi a Zezi ye.

Yaa naoor a tãab la nebã sẽn yeel t’a Pɩɛɛr da bee ne a Zezi wã. La a Pɩɛɛr kɩɩsa naoor a tãabã fãa tɩ pa sɩd ye. Naoor a tãab-n-soabã, a Zezi wẽnegame n ges-⁠a. Yãndã yõka a Pɩɛɛr a sẽn yag ziri wã yĩnga, t’a na n yi yɩng n yãbe.

Arzũmã yibeoog pĩnda, maan-​kʋʋdbã talla a Zezi n kẽng Zʋɩf rãmbã bʋ-​kaoodba ro-​kãseng pʋgẽ. B sõsa ne taab beenẽ n na n bãng b sẽn na n maan a Zezi bũmb ninga. B tall-⁠a lame n kẽng a Põns Pɩlat sẽn yaa Zide naabã nengẽ.

Maan-​kʋʋdbã yeela a Pɩlat yaa: ‘Ra-​kãngã yaa nin-​wẽnga. A segda ne kũum.’ La a Pɩlat sẽn gom ne a Zezi wã poore, a yeelame t’a pa ne a Zezi sẽn maan wẽng ning ye. Rẽ n so t’a Pɩlat kɩt tɩ b tall a Zezi n kẽng a Herood Ãntipas nengẽ. A Herood ra yaa Galile naaba, la a ra bee Zerizalɛm. Yẽ me yãame t’a Zezi pa nin-​wẽng ye, t’a na n kɩt tɩ b tall-⁠a n leb a Pɩlat nengẽ.

A Pɩlat baoome n na n bas a Zezi, la a Zezi bɛɛbã yeelame tɩ b bas bi-​bɛɛg a Barabase. A yaa wagdre. Wĩnto-​sʋk sẽn wa n ta, a Pɩlat talla a Zezi n yi n yeel nebã yaa: ‘Ad-⁠y y rĩmã!’ La maan-​kʋʋdbã kãsem dãmb kaasame n yeel yaa: ‘Kʋ-⁠y-​yã-a! Kʋ-⁠y-​yã-a!’ A Pɩlat kong n basa a Barabas t’a looge, la a kɩt tɩ b tall a Zezi n na n tɩ kʋ.

Arzũmã wĩnd-​kaoore, b kaa a Zezi raoog zugu. B kaa bi-​bees a yiib me. A ye n be a Zezi goabga, t’a to wã be a rɩtgo. B pa wilg-⁠b fotã zug ye. Nand t’a Zezi ki, bi-​bɛɛg a ye n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Fo sã n wa reeg f naamã, bɩ f tẽeg mam yelle.’ A Zezi leoka yẽ yaa: ‘Fo na n zĩnda ne maam arzãnã pʋgẽ.’

A Zezi sẽn kãab raoã bũmb ningã yaa kãab-​noog tɛkẽ! Yãmb mii arzãn ning yell a Zezi sẽn da gomdã sẽn na n yɩ zĩig ningã bɩ? Arzãn ning Wẽnnaam sẽn maan sɩngrẽ wã ra bee yɛ? Pa tẽngã zug sɩda? A Zezi naamã rɩɩb sasã, a na n vʋʋga raoã t’a paam n vɩɩmd arzãnã pʋgẽ tẽngã zugu.
